Name: Carol the Wild Cat Pet
Author: FunnySonny
Description:
About a year and a half ago, I uploaded this mod to the official Chucklefish Forums, and now I've decided "Eh, why not upload it here?" I don't have much to say here, and copy-pasting the description from the forums seems more lazy than just not having anything. The only thing of note is that this was my first mod to any game ever.

INSTALLATION:
-Locate your game files for Stardew Valley
-Back up "cat.xnb" from Stardew Valley/Content/Animals
-Replace cat.xnb from said location with cat.xnb from the .zip

Legal(?)
-I have e-mailed GalaxyTrail about this mod, to which they told me they were fine with as long as I am not charging for it.
